sentences.en: Calculus was discovered separately by Gottfried Leibniz and Isaac Newton.
sentences.zh: 微积分分别由戈特弗里德·莱布尼茨和艾萨克·牛顿独立发现。

sentences.en: Paper, cardboard, glass and garden waste are picked up separately.
sentences.zh: 纸张、硬纸板、玻璃和园艺垃圾要分开收集。

sentences.en: Why is "embaixo" written together and "em cima" written separately?
sentences.zh: 为什么“embaixo”（在下面）写在一起而“em cima”（在上面）却分开来写？
